_about: The agreed structure of the guide (phase 4). Copy to <guide>/outline.json. Order of units = order of pages. validate.py outline checks it. Made-up example values.
_sources_dir: The folder holding the user's uploads, absolute or relative to the guide folder. validate.py and build.py re-check the source map against it.

units.title: Radioactive Decay
units.label: Lecture
units._label: Optional: overrides config unit_label for this unit only.

exam._exam: Optional. The practice exam page. Its time target is practice_minutes in guide.config.json, not here.

sources.note: used for question style and exam weighting; the user will take it themselves, so no answers leak into the guide

_sources: EVERY uploaded file appears here once. kind: slides | transcript | notes | reading | homework | practice-exam | review-sheet | hints | other. A source with no units must say why in use: exam-intel (shapes questions and tags) or excluded (with a note).
